description: Permit outcomes on record for a zoning district (counts by outcome: built, permitted, denied, stalled, withdrawn) from the jurisdiction's open permit data. `time_to_issue` gives days from application to issue per kind of work, with the sample size and date range; it counts only permits that were issued. Never a prediction; aggregate only. Returns { available: false } where no feed has been ingested.
name: outcomes

ingested_through.description: The newest ingest date among the counted permits (YYYY-MM-DD).

title: Permit outcomes for a zoning district
